1.name: Cleanse
1.desc: Removes all disables (excluding suppression and airborne) and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and gives Tenacity.

14.name: Ignite
14.desc: Deals true damage over time to target enemy champion and reduces healing effects on them for the duration.

3.name: Exhaust
3.desc: Slows target enemy champion and reduces their damage dealt.

4.name: Flash
4.desc: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor.

6.name: Ghost
6.desc: Gain Move Speed and ignore unit collision for the duration.

7.name: Heal
7.desc: Restores Health and grants Move Speed to you and target allied champion.

11.name: Smite
11.desc: Deals true damage to a monster or minion.

12.name: Teleport
12.desc: After a brief channel, become untargetable and travel to an allied unit. Upgrades into Unleashed Teleport, which significantly increases travel speed.

8112.name: Electrocute
8112.desc: Hitting a champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities in 3s deals bonus adaptive damage.

8128.name: Dark Harvest
8128.desc: Damaging a low health champion inflicts adaptive damage and harvests a soul from the victim.

9923.name: Hail of Blades
9923.desc: Gain a large amount of Attack Speed and bonus true damage for the first 3 attacks made against enemy champions.

8126.name: Cheap Shot
8126.desc: Deal bonus true damage to enemy champions with impaired movement or actions.

8139.name: Taste of Blood
8139.desc: Heal when you damage an enemy champion.

8143.name: Sudden Impact
8143.desc: Damaging basic attacks and abilities deal bonus true damage to enemy champions after using a dash, leap, blink, teleport, or when leaving stealth.

8137.name: Sixth Sense
8137.desc: On a long Cooldown, automatically sense a nearby untracked and unseen ward, tracking it for the team. Level 11: Also reveal the ward for 10s.

8140.name: Grisly Mementos
8140.desc: Collect 1 memento on champion takedowns , up to 18 total. Gain 6 Trinket Haste for each collected.

8141.name: Deep Ward
8141.desc: Your wards in the enemy jungle are Deep , gaining Health and Duration. Level 9: Wards in the river are also Deep.

8135.name: Treasure Hunter
8135.desc: Unique takedowns grant additional gold the first time they are collected.

8105.name: Relentless Hunter
8105.desc: Unique takedowns grant permanent out of combat MS.

8106.name: Ultimate Hunter
8106.desc: Unique takedowns grant permanent cooldown reduction on your Ultimate.

8351.name: Glacial Augment
8351.desc: Immobilizing an enemy champion will cause 3 glacial rays that slow nearby enemies and reduce their damage to your allies.

8360.name: Unsealed Spellbook
8360.desc: Swap Summoner Spells while out of combat. Swapping to unique Summoner Spells will increase the rate at which you can make future swaps.

8369.name: First Strike
8369.desc: When you initiate champion combat, deal 7% extra damage for 3 seconds and gain gold based on damage dealt.

8306.name: Hextech Flashtraption
8306.desc: While Flash is on cooldown it is replaced by Hexflash. Hexflash : Channel, then blink to a new location.

8304.name: Magical Footwear
8304.desc: You get free boots at 12 min but you cannot buy boots before then. Each takedown you get makes your boots come 45s sooner.

8321.name: Cash Back
8321.desc: Get some gold back when you purchase Legendary Items.

8313.name: Triple Tonic
8313.desc: Upon reaching level 3, gain an Elixir of Avarice. Upon reaching level 6, gain an Elixir of Force. Upon reaching level 9, gain an Elixir of Skill.

8345.name: Biscuit Delivery
8345.desc: Gain a free Biscuit every 2 min, until 6 min. Consuming or selling a Biscuit permanently increases your max health and restores health.

8410.name: Approach Velocity
8410.desc: Bonus MS towards nearby enemy champions that are movement impaired , increased for enemy champions that you impair.

8316.name: Jack Of All Trades
8316.desc: For each different stat gained from items, gain one Jack stack. Each stack grants you 1 Ability Haste. Gain bonus Adaptive Force at 5 and 10 stacks.

8005.name: Press the Attack
8005.desc: Hitting an enemy champion 3 consecutive times deals bonus damage and amplifies your damage until you leave combat with champions.

8008.name: Lethal Tempo
8008.desc: Attacking an enemy champion grants you Attack Speed, up to 6 stacks. At max stacks, deal bonus adaptive damage On-Attack.

8021.name: Fleet Footwork
8021.desc: Attacking and moving builds Energy stacks. At 100 stacks, your next attack heals you and grants increased MS.

8010.name: Conqueror
8010.desc: Gain stacks of adaptive force when attacking enemy champions. After reaching 12 stacks, heal for a portion of damage you deal to champions.

9111.name: Triumph
9111.desc: Takedowns restore 5% of your missing health and grant an additional 20 gold.

8009.name: Presence of Mind
8009.desc: Restore a small amount of mana or energy when damaging an enemy champion. Takedowns restore mana or energy.

9104.name: Legend: Alacrity
9104.desc: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Attack Speed.

9105.name: Legend: Haste
9105.desc: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Basic Ability Haste.

9103.name: Legend: Bloodline
9103.desc: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Life Steal , up to a cap. Once the cap is reached, increase your max health. Weaker earlier but stronger later game than other Legend Runes.

8014.name: Coup de Grace
8014.desc: Deal more damage to low health enemy champions.

8017.name: Cut Down
8017.desc: Deal more damage to high health enemy champions.

8299.name: Last Stand
8299.desc: Deal more damage to champions while you are low on health.

8437.name: Grasp of the Undying
8437.desc: Every 4s your next attack on a champion deals bonus magic damage, heals you, and permanently increases your health.

8439.name: Aftershock
8439.desc: After immobilizing an enemy champion gain defenses and later deal a burst of magic damage around you.

8465.name: Guardian
8465.desc: Guard allies you cast spells on and those that are very nearby. If you or a guarded ally would take damage based on level, you're both granted a shield.

8446.name: Demolish
8446.desc: Your third attack against turrets deals bonus damage.

8463.name: Font of Life
8463.desc: Impairing the movement of an enemy champion heals nearby allied champions.

8401.name: Shield Bash
8401.desc: Whenever you gain a shield, your next basic attack against a champion deals bonus adaptive damage.

8429.name: Conditioning
8429.desc: After 12 min gain +8 Armor and +8 Magic Resist and increase your Armor and Magic Resist by 3%.

8444.name: Second Wind
8444.desc: After taking damage from an enemy champion heal back some missing health over time.

8473.name: Bone Plating
8473.desc: After taking damage from an enemy champion, the next 3 spells or attacks you receive from them deal 30-60 (based on level) less damage. Duration: 1.5s Cooldown: 55s

8451.name: Overgrowth
8451.desc: Gain permanent max health when minions or monsters die near you.

8453.name: Revitalize
8453.desc: Gain 5% Heal and Shield Power. Heals and shields you cast or receive are 10% stronger on targets below 40% health.

8242.name: Unflinching
8242.desc: Gain Armor and Magic Resist when receiving crowd control.

8214.name: Summon Aery
8214.desc: Your attacks and abilities send Aery to a target, damaging enemies or shielding allies.

8229.name: Arcane Comet
8229.desc: Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a damaging comet at their location.

8230.name: Stormraider's Surge
8230.desc: Dealing 25% of a champion's maximum health grants a burst of MS and Slow Resist.

8992.name: Deathfire Touch
8992.desc: Damaging a champion with an ability burns them over time.

8224.name: Axiom Arcanist
8224.desc: Your Ultimate has increased damage, healing, and shielding. Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion reduces your Ultimate's current cooldown.

8226.name: Manaflow Band
8226.desc: Hitting an enemy champion with an ability permanently increases your maximum mana by 25, up to 250 mana. After reaching 250 bonus mana, restore 1% of your missing mana every 5 seconds.

8275.name: Nimbus Cloak
8275.desc: After casting a Summoner Spell, gain a short Move Speed increase that allows you to pass through units.

8210.name: Transcendence
8210.desc: Gain bonuses upon reaching the following levels: Level 5: +5 Ability Haste Level 8: +5 Ability Haste Level 11: On Champion takedown, reduce the remaining cooldown of basic abilities by 20%.

8234.name: Celerity
8234.desc: All Move Speed bonuses are 7% more effective on you and gain 1% Move Speed.

8233.name: Absolute Focus
8233.desc: While above 70% health, gain extra adaptive damage.

8237.name: Scorch
8237.desc: Your first damaging ability hit every 10s burns champions.

8232.name: Waterwalking
8232.desc: Gain MS and AP or AD, adaptive in the river.

8236.name: Gathering Storm
8236.desc: Gain increasing amounts of AD or AP, adaptive over the course of the game.
